// A color in hue-saturation-lightness form; Hue is an angle around the color wheel.
// Same model family as HSV: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HSL_and_HSV
type ColorHSL
    implements IValue
{
    Hue: Angle;
    Saturation: Number;
    Lightness: Number;
}
